name: storyboard-parsing
description: Run the OpenSCENARIO storyboard parsing pipeline (Transcription/Translation/Interpretation strategies) on the active .xosc file.

commands.title: Storyboard: Run Pipeline on Active File

storyboard.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter that can import osc2cr_extended and the commonroad-openscenario-converter.

storyboard.storyboardParsingPath.description: Absolute path to the osc2cr_extended/web directory (contains vscode_bridge.py). Required because once this extension is installed, it no longer lives next to that checkout. Leave empty if osc2cr_extended is installed into the interpreter above.

storyboard.timeoutSeconds.description: Kill the pipeline if it hasn't finished after this many seconds (esmini can hang on some scenarios).
